name: Ember
notes: Emberpup's move 1 (A). Sets the tile in front of the user on fire for 1-3 s; whatever steps in burns at once, then every half second while it stays (each monster has its own timer). Wild monsters only use it when the player is within 2 tiles; the player's goes off anyway. Charge: 3 s. Wild Emberpups use it every 4 s.
title: EMBER
